E2: offer 939f1ead-438e-48b4-b2d6-8ac5e57af772 revoked by the pause, the late accept got OFFER_REVOKED, Far had the order next.

## Restore into an empty database (deploy/restore.sh); over data it refuses
Restored blizz.dump into blizz_restored: 115 migrations applied. Start the server on it with the same ERASURE_JOURNAL_DIR.
Database blizz_restored is not empty (116 tables): restore only into an empty database

In the restored database before the server starts: `ACTIVE +380687482070` (the backup predates the deletion).

## Start the server on the restored database with the same journal: the deletion is applied again

After the start: `ANONYMIZED -`.
